subject: Biology
topic: Why do fingers wrinkle in water?
title: Why Do Fingers Wrinkle in Water?
summary: Skin soaking up water is not the full story: a finger with nerve damage stays smooth. How the nervous system makes wrinkles, and why their purpose is still debated.

notes.title: 03 – Why Do Fingers Wrinkle in Water?

keyPoints: Fingers with **nerve damage** do not wrinkle normally, so wrinkling is not just water absorption.
After a few minutes in water, the **nervous system** makes blood vessels in the fingertip narrow.
Fingertip **volume falls** and the skin is pulled down into wrinkles.
A **2013** study found wet objects were moved faster with wrinkled fingers (reported as about 12%).
A **2014** study could not repeat this, so the purpose is still an open question.

head: Study
Result
rows: Wet objects moved faster with wrinkled fingers; no difference for dry objects

quiz.q: The purpose of finger wrinkles is:
